title: RumVitalWebsocketConnectingEvent
description: Schema for the vital reported when a WebSocket connection is created. Reported exactly once per connection, when the WebSocket is constructed. Reported with vital.name websocket_connecting

websocket.description: WebSocket properties. The identity of the connection is reported on this vital only, and is not repeated on the vitals of the later phases

url.description: URL the connection was opened on, without its query string

requested_protocols.description: Subprotocols the connection was requested with. Omitted when none was requested

connecting_date.description: Date the WebSocket was constructed, in ms from epoch
